summaries.help-me: Stuck? It interviews your agent about this session, then proposes a route through other prompts. Start here.
summaries.repo-recon: Maps an unfamiliar codebase from entry points, seams and git churn. Twelve reads, five sections, read-only.
summaries.pr-review: Judges a diff by tiers — correctness, blast radius, failure mode, reversibility, design fit. No praise, no nits.
summaries.bug-repro: Reproduces before fixing, then stops. Falsifiable claim, shortest repro, failing/passing boundary.
summaries.grill-me: Attacks your idea instead of encouraging it. Finds the weakest load-bearing assumption and asks what would falsify it.
summaries.ticket-intake: Takes a support intake like a good first-line engineer, then drafts one ticket a stranger could act on.
summaries.welcome-tour: A host prompt: a company guiding a visiting agent through its services. Reads nothing of yours.
summaries.ghost-in-the-gist: A three-move ASCII terminal game. No engine — the document is the interpreter spec.
summaries.handoff-note: Writes the note that lets a cold reader resume your work: state, next action, decisions with reasons.
summaries.fpa-bootstrap: Teaches the protocol itself to an agent that has never heard of it, refusals included.
